objectifs: Impersonal passive: it is said that…

etapes.fr: Les journaux utilisent souvent le passif impersonnel pour rester prudents.
etapes.en: News uses the impersonal passive to stay neutral.

exemples.en: It is said that the bridge will open soon.
exemples.fr: On dit que le pont ouvrira bientôt.

exemples.en: The minister is expected to resign.
Prices are reported to have risen by 10%.

etapes.fr: Lecture : « Heavy rains have caused floods in several districts of Abidjan. Hundreds of families are reported to have lost their homes. The government is expected to announce emergency measures today. »
etapes.en: Read the article and notice the passive forms.

etapes.question: « The president is expected to speak » =

etapes.en: The company is said to be very profitable
etapes.fr: On dit que l'entreprise est très rentable
On pense que les prix vont baisser.
reponses: It is thought that prices will fall.
It is believed that prices will fall.
Prices are thought to be falling.
It's thought that prices will fall.

etapes.en: Breaking news: the match has been postponed.
choix: Dernière minute : le match a été reporté.
Dernière minute : le match a été gagné.

etapes.en: Hundreds of families are reported to have lost their homes.
etapes.fr: Des centaines de familles auraient perdu leur maison.

resume: It is said/thought/believed that… / X is said/expected/reported to… News words: headline, breaking news, rise, fall.
devoir: Read a short English news article online and summarise it in 4 sentences.
